messages:
Nate: Rain hitting the windows tonight. looking for a low-key binge (tv/movie) + a short playlist to read to. nothing too upbeat.
Lina: Ooh mood. For TV, 'Patriot' if you haven't seen it 
(weird, deadpan, excellent rain scenes).
Asha: Movie rec: 'In the Mood for Love' 
perfect for rainy reading pauses.
Marco: Playlist: lo-fi guitar, some modern folk, quiet voice. I'll drop a 20-min mix in a sec.
Jenny: voted: romantic melancholy bundle pls :handshake: are you reading something specific?
Nate: just some essays and short stories. need low distraction background.
Marco: here ya go: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-rainy-mix (20 min loop) 
Asha: also 'Coltrane Ballads' is a soft option if you want acoustic jazz vibes.
Lina: if you want serialized short episodes, try 'Black Mirror' (select episodes only) or 'Russian Doll' for a mood that's cozy but odd.
Jenny: book rec for similar vibe: 'Olive Kitteridge' short, dense and rainy-feeling.
Nate: PollBot? which pairing should I try first (vote with :one: :two: :three:)?
PollBot: Poll created by Nate: "Rainy night pairing" 
1\ufe0f  In the Mood for Love + Coltrane Ballads
PollBot: 2\ufe0f  Patriot + Marco's rainy mix
PollBot: 3\ufe0f  Russian Doll (select eps) + lo-fi guitar playlist
Lina: voted :one:.
Asha: voted :one: and :two:.
Marco: voted :two:.
Jenny: voted :three:.
Nate: voted :two:. thanks team, will report back which combo makes me forget the time :coffee:
